title: CO2-mediated conversion of furfuryl alcohol to 4-hydroxycyclopentanone and its toxicological assessment
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6SU00193A, Communication
Open Access

Ana Franco, Marie Garcia, K. De Oliveira Vigier, Julien Vignard, Isabelle P. Oswald, Frédéric Guegan, Gladys Mirey, François Jérôme
Through a combined chemical-toxicological study, this report re-explores the Piancatelli rearrangement of furfuryl alcohol into 4-hydroxycyclopentenone (4-HCP), a key building block for the synthesis of bio-based solvents.
